01 / RAG & LLM Engineering

Nimde — Local Research Assistant

A local-first assistant for researchers to query academic papers with verifiable, source-grounded citations.

THE CONTEXT & PROBLEM

Academic literature reviews often suffer from hallucinated citations and manual cross-referencing friction. Nimde is an offline-capable, local-first research companion designed to parse PDFs, build literature matrices, and provide evidence-grounded answers. Built with ChromaDB and local Ollama models, it preserves researcher privacy while delivering precise document synthesis.

MY ROLE & CONTRIBUTION

Team Lead and AI Engineering Lead: designed query processing pipelines, prompt structures, vector index tuning, and empirical evaluation harnesses.

TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS & ARCHITECTURE

  • Rigorous retrieval evaluation testing multiple embedding models against benchmark paper queries.
  • Chunking optimization preserving tables, academic formulas, and section context.
  • Direct attribution linking generated claims back to exact source page numbers.
